_about: Judgment constants of the governance stack, read from hooks/ by redteam/live.py. Standing registry since 2026-11-12 (first made 2026-10-19 on main 7d07886 as a one-off under results/; that copy failed against the live hooks on 2026-11-12 with 6 drifted values and 15 unregistered ones). Status per the red-team skill's five. The guard runs registry_check.py on every commit.

constants.name: CLASS_PATTERN_ANALYSIS
constants.role: classifier: analysis class -> adversarial-verify; trigger + Stop gate

constants.name: CLASS_PATTERN_REVIEW
constants.role: classifier: review class -> adversarial-verify; trigger + Stop gate

constants.name: CLASS_PATTERN_BUILD
constants.role: classifier: build class -> plan-gate; trigger + Stop gate

constants.name: CLASS_PATTERN_DISPUTE
constants.role: classifier: dispute class -> adversarial-verify + scope-fence

constants.name: CLASS_PATTERN_REQUIREMENT
constants.role: classifier: requirement class, advisory only

constants.name: ENFORCED_CLASSES
constants.role: classes the Stop gate blocks on; a trivial prompt in one of them is blocked despite the trigger's skip clause

constants.name: HARNESS_MARKERS
constants.role: user-entry prefixes that are not owner requests; slash-command echoes are absent (attack G5)

constants.name: GOV_GATE_ANY_ONE_GOVERNOR_SUFFICES
constants.role: Stop gate passes when ANY needed governor loaded; a dispute needs two (attack G4) — fixed 2026-10-20 (red-team attack G4): each enforced class's primary governor is required

constants.name: GOV_GATE_LOADED_MATCH_IS_SUBSTRING_OF_INPUT
constants.role: Stop gate counts a governor as loaded if its name appears anywhere in any Skill call's input (attack G3) — fixed 2026-10-20 (attack G3): exact match on the Skill name

constants.name: GOV_GATE_RETRIES
constants.role: blocks at most once per turn (stop_hook_active loop guard)

constants.name: RECEIPT_INABILITY_PATTERN
constants.role: receipt gate: what counts as an inability claim; misses curly apostrophes and paraphrases (R2-R4)

constants.name: RECEIPT_RECEIPT_PATTERN
constants.role: receipt gate: what counts as a receipt; matched anywhere in the turn, substrings like 'ran ' (R5-R6)

constants.name: REMINDER_FIRES_PER_SESSION
constants.role: first-write reminders fire once per session, re-armed on compaction

constants.name: REMINDER_JQ_PATH
constants.role: absolute jq path in the two first-write reminders; elsewhere degrades to one firing per machine (M2) — fixed 2026-10-20 (D-GF-8): python3 reads the JSON

constants.name: BAND_HOOK_WIRED
constants.role: red-team band reminder is not wired anywhere

constants.name: BAND_HOOK_SOURCE
constants.role: band reminder trigger (± with no band word), advisory

constants.name: HOOK_TIMEOUTS_S
constants.role: per-hook timeouts in seconds

constants.name: TRIGGER_EVAL_GATE_TEXT
constants.value: >=5/6 should-fire runs fire; 4/4 should-not runs stay silent
constants.role: evals/red-team.json silent gate reads >=3/4; the hypothesis says 4/4

constants.name: DESCRIPTION_FAIL_CHARS
constants.role: lint fails a description over the claude.ai upload cap

constants.name: DESCRIPTION_WARN_CHARS
constants.role: lint warns inside 24 chars of the cap

constants.name: CUE_MIN_WORDS
constants.role: advisory cue tier: shortest owner prompt that gets a governance cue

constants.name: CUE_ACK_PATTERN
constants.role: advisory cue tier: acknowledgements that get no cue

constants.name: TRIVIA_MAX_CHARS
constants.role: Stop gate: review-only, no-tool answers under this length are not blocked

constants.name: RECEIPT_WINDOW_CHARS
constants.role: receipt law: how near a receipt must sit to an inability claim

constants.name: TURN_OUTWARD_TOOL_SUFFIXES
constants.role: turn gate F1: tool names that count as an outward action

constants.name: TURN_OUTWARD_BASH_PATTERN
constants.role: turn gate F1: shell commands that count as an outward action

constants.name: TURN_WRITE_BASH_PATTERN
constants.role: turn gate F3: shell commands that count as a first write

constants.name: TURN_PLAN_MARK_PATTERN
constants.role: turn gate F3: what counts as a plan having been shown (the word Goal)

constants.name: TURN_MERGE_WORD_PATTERN
constants.role: turn gate F2: what counts as the owner's merge word

constants.name: TURN_MERGE_NEGATION_PATTERN
constants.role: turn gate F2: negations that cancel a merge word, and how many words back they reach

constants.name: TURN_SCHEDULED_HEADER_PATTERN
constants.role: turn gates: what marks a scheduled run as a turn of its own

constants.name: TURN_PLAN_GATE_MODE
constants.role: turn gate F3 mode

constants.name: CARD_REMINDER_LIST_PATTERN
constants.role: decision-cards reminder: what counts as a '(Recommended)' list line
